newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS gas and distillates rise with APIs.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS gas and distillates rise with APIs.

text.p: U.S. unleaded gasoline and distillate futures rose on ACCESS trade, following the release of new inventory data Tuesday that showed drops in distillate and gasoline supplies, traders said.
The American Petroleum Institute (API) reported nationwide distillate stocks fell a steep 4.7 million barrels to 96.3 million last week, while gasoline dropped 1.9 million to 195 million.
"The (API) numbers tonight were bullish in heat and gas," a trader said.
May gasoline rose 0.58 cents a gallon to 62.35 cents Tuesday, amid volume of 314 lots traded and 625 overall.
After-hours, NYMEX May heating oil rose 0.42 cents to 55.25 cents while volume reached 86 lots in the front-month and 169 overall.
After May crude expired, June traded up a slight six cents a barrel to $19.65, as stocks were reported up 1.4 million barrels last week, by API.
